items.title: Palo Alto Networks soars on Q1 earnings and Applied Compute deal
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks hiked its fiscal 2027 guidance, signaling that customers are spending more to protect AI systems.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures: Techs Slide, Anthropic Retreats After Ugly Market Reversal To New Lows
items.summary: Tech futures fell after the market suffered an ugly reversal, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq hitting new lows. Anthropic retreated late after rising its IPO debut.

items.title: Why CrowdStrike Holdings Stock Flew While the Market Flopped Today
items.summary: A fellow cybersecurity company posted a very encouraging quarterly earnings report.

items.title: AI Hacking Is “a Fantastic Bonanza” for CrowdStrike and Palo Alto, per Paul Kedrosky
items.summary: Key TakeawaysPaul Kedrosky called the flood of AI-found software flaws “a fantastic bonanza” for CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks. Patching at five to ten times past levels makes security a volume business, with Zscaler and Microsoft in the same wave.

items.title: Palo Alto’s CEO Says AI Security “Could Be Bigger Than What We Do Today.” Here’s the Math
items.summary: Key TakeawaysPalo Alto Networks beat its guidance and raised its fiscal 2027 revenue outlook, and shares jumped 6%. CEO Nikesh Arora’s own figures put AI security spending at $30 billion to $50 billion a year by 2029, more than analysts expect Palo Alto and CrowdStrike to bring in combined in fiscal 2029.

items.title: Bridgewater Warns of AI Security Risk as Anthropic Shares Rise in Debut
items.summary: Bridgewater Associates laid out its thinking on artificial intelligence-related risks in a paper published last week.

items.title: Anthropic’s IPO Showed AI’s Upside. Bridgewater Is Preparing for a Cyber Shock.
items.summary: Anthropic’s record IPO showed demand for AI exposure. A wave of outages has brought the risks to critical infrastructure into focus.

items.title: Zscaler Stocks Jump 8.18% as Palo Alto Forecast Lifts Cybersecurity Names
items.summary: Investors are betting AI-enabled attacks will force bigger security budgets, and Zscaler grew ARR 25% last quarter.
